source.title: Cliopatria
source.attribution: Cliopatria v0.2.1 by the Seshat Global History Databank, CC BY 4.0. Maproom clipped, oriented, simplified and rendered these source polygons for a historical geography game.

snapshotConvention: Each asset is a Maproom-generated view of one selected POLITY, framed to its curated regional or global window at sampleYear. Its accepted date interval is the inclusive source interval shared by every displayed geometry. The map has no labels before a guess and is not an archival map or a complete inventory of historical societies.

maps.visibleClue: This river plain lies at the head of the Persian Gulf, where the Tigris and Euphrates approach one another.
maps.historicalContext: The earliest selected frame is a reconstruction of the city-state landscape of southern Mesopotamia. The source window spans several centuries, so the outline supports an era guess rather than a precise event date.
maps.uncertainty: The accepted interval is the inclusive Cliopatria FromYear–ToYear range for the displayed Sumerian City-States geometry. Cliopatria supplies one scholarly reconstruction without per-polygon confidence values. This selected polity map does not show every contemporaneous community, dependency or political relationship.
